text: row 15: the real session of 2026-08-01-02-19-17, the whole opening sentence written twice. The rotation merged the salvaged interim with the last one, and google had rewritten the tail («دیگه بشه مثلاً ۶ ماهه» became «یادش نره»): same head, neither a substring of the other, so the sticky merge kept both and carry doubled. The salvage inputs are recorded now, so replay redoes the merge instead of trusting its result: before this the golden corpus could not see this step at all. The expect shows the rule: the final's wording wins where it covers, and only the part of the salvage it did not cover survives. One copy of the sentence, no word lost.
